sentences: == Funding == In 2025 Wispr raised US$30 million in a Series A funding round led by Menlo Ventures, with participation from NEA, 8VC and several individual investors, including Evan Sharp and Henry Ward.
In August 2026, Wispr Flow raised $280 million in a Series B funding round led by Menlo Ventures at a valuation of $2 billion.
